title: VidEdit3D: Flexible 3D Gaussian Editing with Video Diffusion
title_zh: VidEdit3D：基于视频扩散的灵活3D高斯编辑

paragraphs.en: Recent advancements in text-guided 3D editing, particularly with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), have shown promise but still lag behind the flexibility of 2D editing tools. Existing methods face a critical trade-off between preserving multi-view consistency and allowing structural modifications. Image-based editors can also struggle to apply the intended edit to objects viewed from unusual angles. To address these limitations, we introduce VidEdit3D, a framework that reformulates 3D scene editing as a trajectory-based video editing task. By drawing a parallel between camera movement in static 3D scenes and temporal dynamics in video, we leverage the robust spatiotemporal priors of pre-trained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) to encourage semantic and structural coherence across views. Specifically, we propose Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR) to select informative keyframes and construct smooth video clips aligned with VDM input requirements. To propagate edits from an anchor view to these clips, we develop Flow-Aligned Video Editing (FAVE), a training-free framework incorporating an Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG) mechanism. ECG contrasts source and edited image conditions at a shared latent state, using scheduled source-image amplification to strengthen adherence to the edited reference while maintaining original scene context. Finally, we introduce Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS) to strictly confine geometric and appearance updates to target primitives, reducing background attribute leakage. Experiments demonstrate stronger instruction alignment and better multi-view consistency than the baselines.

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in text-guided image editing have demonstrated remarkable success in enabling users to modify images according to natural language instructions [ 3 , 14 , 43 ] . By leveraging large-scale diffusion or transformer-based models, these systems can generate semantically aligned and visually coherent edits, such as replacing objects, altering styles, or modifying attributes, while preserving content fidelity. This paradigm has significantly democratized content creation, making intuitive visual editing accessible to non-experts. Building upon this progress, researchers have recently extended text-driven editing to the 3D domain, particularly in neural implicit representations such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) [ 36 ] and explicit point-based representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 18 ] . Particularly, compared with NeRF, 3DGS offers greater flexibility and efficiency as an explicit 3D representation, enabling high-quality real-time rendering and fine-grained local editing. These advantages make 3DGS editing an attractive paradigm for controllable 3D content manipulation, which is the focus of our paper.
paragraphs.zh: 近期文本引导图像编辑的进展表明，在让用户能够根据自然语言指令修改图像方面已取得显著成功 [3, 14, 43]。 通过利用大规模扩散模型或基于 Transformer 的模型，这些系统能够生成语义一致且视觉连贯的编辑，例如替换物体、改变风格或修改属性，同时保持内容的保真度。 这一范式极大地普及了内容创作，使非专业人士也能进行直观的视觉编辑。 在这一进展的基础上，研究人员最近将文本驱动的编辑扩展到了三维领域，尤其是在神经隐式表示（如神经辐射场 NeRFs）[36] 和显式点基表示（如三维高斯泼溅 3DGS）[18] 中。 特别地，与 NeRF 相比，3DGS 作为一种显式三维表示具有更强的灵活性和更高的效率，能够实现高质量的实时渲染和细粒度的局部编辑。 这些优势使 3DGS 编辑成为可控三维内容操作的一种有吸引力的范式，而这正是我们论文的关注焦点。

paragraphs.en: However, despite the potential of 3DGS, the capabilities of existing 3D editing frameworks still lag significantly behind their 2D counterparts. Many 3D editing methods focus on operations such as global style transfer, texture modification, or object removal. This stands in stark contrast to state-of-the-art 2D editing tools, which support highly imaginative and complex transformations with ease. A primary bottleneck restricting 3D editing flexibility is the requirement for multi-view consistency; unlike 2D editing, modifying a 3D scene requires simultaneous adjustments across multiple viewpoints while ensuring the underlying geometry remains coherent. Early attempts that naively applied 2D editors independently across different views inherently lacked cross-view coherence [ 13 , 9 , 47 ] , leading to severe artifacts such as ghosting and flickering. To mitigate these inconsistencies, subsequent works [ 53 , 49 , 8 ] introduced geometric guidance through depth or correspondence with the original images. While these constraints stabilize the optimization process, strong alignment to the source can limit editing flexibility. This limitation becomes particularly evident in instructions that require structural changes. For instance, a simple instruction like “make the person wear a hat” becomes difficult to execute when the required geometric addition conflicts with alignment constraints derived from the original shape.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，尽管3DGS潜力巨大，现有3D编辑框架的能力仍显著落后于其2D对应方案。 许多3D编辑方法专注于全局风格迁移、纹理修改或物体移除等操作。 这与最先进的2D编辑工具形成鲜明对比，后者能够轻松支持高度想象力和复杂的变换。 限制3D编辑灵活性的一个主要瓶颈是对多视角一致性的要求；与2D编辑不同，修改3D场景需要同时在多个视角进行调整，同时确保底层几何结构保持连贯。 早期尝试在不同视角间简单地独立应用2D编辑器，天然缺乏跨视角的一致性[13, 9, 47]，导致鬼影和闪烁等严重伪影。 为了缓解这些不一致性，后续工作[53, 49, 8]通过深度或与原始图像的对应关系引入了几何引导。 虽然这些约束能稳定优化过程，但对源图像的强对齐可能限制编辑的灵活性。 这一局限在需要结构性改变的指令中尤为明显。 例如，当所需的几何新增与源自原始形状的对齐约束冲突时，诸如“给这个人戴上一顶帽子”这样简单的指令就变得难以执行。

paragraphs.en: These limitations motivate the design of a flexible 3D editing framework capable of performing precise semantic manipulations without the excessive rigidity of geometric locks. To achieve this, we introduce VidEdit3D (Fig. 1 ), which takes an edit created in a single view with a 2D editor, propagates it across viewpoints, and reconstructs the edited 3D scene. To robustly facilitate this propagation, we identify a powerful parallel between temporal consistency in videos and multi-view consistency in the rendered frames of a 3D scene. A camera trajectory moving around a static 3D object yields a sequence of frames that is structurally analogous to a video clip. This insight inspires us to leverage the robust spatiotemporal priors of pre-trained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) [ 44 , 22 , 2 , 16 , 58 ] . VDMs are designed to maintain object identity and semantic coherence across time, providing a useful prior for relating 3D viewpoints. ViP3DE [ 6 ] also propagates a single edited view into 3D using motion-preserved noise blending and geometry-aware denoising. VidEdit3D strengthens reference transfer through an explicit contrast between source and edited image conditions, while spatial source regularization preserves the surrounding scene. Our inversion-free formulation allows the edited region to change without enforcing source-geometry feature correspondences during denoising. In our comparisons, VidEdit3D achieves stronger instruction alignment and better multi-view consistency than ViP3DE, including when both use the same video backbone.

paragraphs.en: To transform sparse 3D renderings into a form compatible with video diffusion models, we introduce a Trajectory-Guided Rendering (TGR) strategy. Starting from a user-selected anchor, TGR selects views of the source subject carrying the edit and connects them into a smooth camera trajectory. We propagate along two branches from the anchor to shorten the sequence of transfers to distant views and reduce error accumulation. Overlapping clips maintain continuity within each branch while matching video diffusion priors.

paragraphs.en: In standard image-to-video (I2V) generation, classifier-free guidance (CFG) [ 15 ] evaluates the denoiser twice under different text conditions, while both evaluations typically share the same first-frame image as the temporal anchor. This design is effective for video synthesis, since a fixed first-frame condition helps preserve object identity and temporal coherence over time. In contrast, FAVE, as an inversion-free editing method, conceptually requires two distinct conditioning roles: one should follow the edited reference frame and target prompt, while the other should preserve the original scene structure under the source frame and source prompt. However, directly reusing the standard I2V conditioning scheme in our setting leads both evaluations to remain anchored to the same edited first frame, rather than forming the desired source-versus-target contrast. In I2V models, this mismatch is exacerbated by the strong first-frame anchoring effect: later frames remain strongly influenced by the first-frame image condition, which can make the two evaluations inherit similar image-conditioned components and weaken the intended guidance contrast. To address this issue, we introduce Editing Consistency Guidance (ECG), a training-free inference-time guidance scheme that restores a meaningful source-versus-edit contrast in the guidance computation. Specifically, ECG amplifies the source concatenation condition early in sampling, then replaces it with edited-frame features while retaining source text and cross-attention conditioning. FAVE complements this guidance with source-sequence and spatial constraints that preserve camera motion and unedited content.
paragraphs.zh: 在标准的图像到视频（I2V）生成中，无分类器引导（CFG）[ 15 ] 在不同文本条件下对去噪器进行两次评估，而这两次评估通常共享相同的首帧图像作为时间锚点。 这种设计对视频合成是有效的，因为固定的首帧条件有助于在时间推移过程中保持物体的身份信息和时间一致性。 相比之下，FAVE 作为一种无需反转的编辑方法，在概念上需要两种不同的条件作用角色：一种应遵循编辑后的参考帧和目标提示词，另一种应在源帧和源提示词下保持原始场景结构。 然而，在我们的设置中直接复用标准的 I2V 条件作用方案，会使两次评估都继续锚定在同一个编辑后的首帧上，而不是形成期望的源与目标之间的对比。 在 I2V 模型中，这种不匹配被强烈的首帧锚定效应所加剧：后续帧仍然受到首帧图像条件的强烈影响，这可能使两次评估继承相似的图像条件成分，从而削弱预期的引导对比。 为了解决这个问题，我们引入了编辑一致性引导（ECG），这是一种免训练的推理时引导方案，能够在引导计算中恢复有意义的源与编辑之间的对比。 具体而言，ECG 在采样早期放大源拼接条件，然后将其替换为编辑后帧的特征，同时保留源文本和交叉注意力条件。 FAVE 通过保留相机运动和未编辑内容的源序列约束与空间约束来补充这种引导。

paragraphs.en: During 3D optimization, existing 3D editing methods [ 9 , 49 , 8 , 53 , 26 ] can suffer from global attribute leakage, where gradients intended for the target object erroneously update the entire scene. Explicit spatial control keeps the refinement localized to the intended target. To address this issue, we introduce Region-Selective 3DGS Refinement (RS-GS), a method that explicitly constrains the refinement to the target region by back-projecting 2D segmentation masks into 3D space and using depth-guided filtering to select the corresponding Gaussians. By confining the optimization to these back-projected primitives while freezing all others, RS-GS ensures that geometric and appearance updates are confined to the edited regions.
paragraphs.zh: 在3D优化过程中，现有的3D编辑方法 [ 9 , 49 , 8 , 53 , 26 ] 可能会出现全局属性泄漏问题，即本应作用于目标物体的梯度错误地更新了整个场景。 显式空间控制使细化过程局限于预定目标。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了区域选择性3DGS细化（RS-GS），该方法通过将2D分割掩码反投影到3D空间，并利用深度引导滤波来选择对应的高斯，从而显式地将细化约束在目标区域内。 通过将优化限制在这些反投影的基元上并冻结其余所有基元，RS-GS 确保几何与外观的更新仅局限于被编辑的区域。

paragraphs.en: A significant body of work has explored editing 3D scenes (NeRFs [ 36 ] or 3DGS [ 18 ] ) through optimization or distillation strategies. Early implicit approaches relied on mesh scaffolds or interactive distillation [ 60 , 17 ] , while subsequent explicit methods utilize iterative optimization to distill 2D diffusion priors into 3D representations [ 9 , 23 , 47 ] . Recent advancements further enhance quality through identity-preserving noise estimation [ 20 ] or task-specific optimization for style transfer and virtual try-on [ 32 , 5 ] . However, ensuring multi-view consistency remains a primary bottleneck. To address this, several methods use geometric guidance such as depth or epipolar alignment [ 53 , 8 , 49 , 26 , 12 ] . Some methods use per-scene fine-tuning [ 50 , 65 ] , while others train generalized multi-view editors on paired data [ 61 , 7 ] . ViP3DE [ 6 ] propagates an edited view through motion-preserved noise blending and geometry-aware denoising. VidEdit3D uses inversion-free source–edit conditioning to drive the requested change, together with spatial source regularization that is weaker inside the edited region and stronger outside it. This separates edit transfer from preservation of surrounding content, and our comparisons with ViP3DE show gains in both instruction alignment and multi-view consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 已有大量工作探索了通过优化或蒸馏策略来编辑三维场景（NeRF [36] 或 3DGS [18]）。 早期的隐式方法依赖于网格支架或交互式蒸馏 [60, 17]，而后续的显式方法则利用迭代优化将二维扩散先验蒸馏到三维表示中 [9, 23, 47]。 最近的进展通过保持身份的噪声估计 [20]，或针对风格迁移与虚拟试穿的任务特定优化 [32, 5]，进一步提升了质量。 然而，确保多视角一致性仍然是一个主要瓶颈。 为解决这一问题，若干方法采用几何引导，例如深度或极线对齐 [53, 8, 49, 26, 12]。 一些方法使用逐场景微调 [50, 65]，另一些方法则在成对数据上训练通用的多视角编辑器 [61, 7]。 ViP3DE [6] 通过保持运动的噪声混合和几何感知去噪来传播已编辑的视图。 VidEdit3D 使用无需反演的源—编辑条件来驱动所请求的编辑，并结合空间源正则化，该正则化在编辑区域内较弱、在编辑区域外较强。 这将编辑传递与周围内容的保留分离开来，我们与 ViP3DE 的对比显示，在指令对齐和多视角一致性两方面均有所提升。

paragraphs.en: For image editing, SDEdit balances realism and fidelity through noising and denoising [ 35 ] . With diffusion transformer (DiT) backbones and rectified flows [ 38 , 34 ] , later methods reduce inversion drift through ODE solvers, noise alignment [ 10 , 46 , 55 ] , or history-guided velocity correction [ 45 ] . Other methods preserve structure through attention and feature control [ 14 , 43 , 29 ] . MasaCtrl supports non-rigid edits with mutual self-attention [ 4 ] , while KV-Edit and FreeFlux use DiT-specific key-value reuse for background-preserving, task-adaptive editing [ 64 , 52 ] . Video editing adds temporal coherence: cross-frame attention control and fusion [ 33 , 39 ] and space-time modulation [ 57 ] reduce drift and improve fine-grained control. I2V methods propagate first-frame edits using temporal features or motion–content alignment [ 24 , 30 ] , whereas FlowDirector uses inversion-free ODE steering [ 27 ] . Complex motion and large appearance or shape changes remain challenging.

paragraphs.en: Given a reconstructed 3D Gaussian scene, calibrated source views, an edited anchor image, and source and target prompts, VidEdit3D produces an edited 3D scene. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , our pipeline consists of three stages: (1) TGR converts selected multi-view renderings into smooth video clips; (2) FAVE propagates edits across the clip through a trajectory-regularized flow formulation, augmented with ECG for semantic alignment and a dynamic attention mask for background preservation; and (3) RS-GS lifts the edited frames back into 3D via depth-constrained back-projection, confining updates to the target Gaussians to preserve scene-wide consistency.

paragraphs.en: To exploit the spatiotemporal priors of video diffusion models for 3D editing, we need to reduce the mismatch between multi-view renderings and the smooth temporal patterns commonly observed in natural videos. When consecutive camera views are far apart or presented in an irregular order, objects can shift abruptly in the image or reveal different surfaces between frames. An I2V model may then produce inconsistent appearances or shapes for the same object across views. TGR addresses this mismatch by selecting informative views and connecting them into smooth camera trajectories for edit propagation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了利用视频扩散模型的时空先验进行3D编辑，我们需要减少多视角渲染与自然视频中普遍存在的平滑时序模式之间的不匹配。 当相邻的相机视角相距较远或以不规则的顺序呈现时，物体可能在图像中发生突然的位移，或在帧间展现出不同的表面。 此时，I2V 模型可能在不同的视角之间为同一物体生成不一致的外观或形状。 TGR 通过选择信息量大的视角并将它们连接成平滑的相机轨迹以进行编辑传播，来解决这种不匹配。

paragraphs.en: Given the reordered keyframes, we construct a dense camera trajectory via Kochanek–Bartels spline interpolation [ 21 ] . The trajectory is rendered into consecutive clips with shared boundary frames. Both branches begin with the same edited anchor. Within each branch, the edited last frame of one clip conditions the next, maintaining continuity as the edit travels toward the meeting keyframe. Bidirectional propagation thus keeps each transfer chain short while retaining a common reference for the two sides of the trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 给定重排后的关键帧，我们通过 Kochanek–Bartels 样条插值 [ 21 ] 构建一条稠密的相机轨迹。 该轨迹被渲染成多个共享边界帧的连续片段。 两个分支都以相同的编辑锚点开始。 在每个分支内，一个片段经编辑的末帧作为条件引导下一个片段，使编辑向交汇关键帧传播时保持连续性。 因此，双向传播在保持轨迹两侧拥有共同参考的同时，使每条传递链都保持较短。

paragraphs.en: A central challenge in our setting is that the rendered multi-view sequence corresponds to a static 3D scene observed along a camera trajectory. Therefore, during edit propagation, the desired variation should come from viewpoint change alone, while the subject layout, pose, and spatial placement should remain stable across frames. In practice, however, off-the-shelf video editing models [ 57 , 48 , 11 , 27 , 30 ] often introduce spurious object motion or geometric drift, which is particularly harmful for 3D editing.

In our setting, however, this formulation is problematic when computing the guided prediction v p v_{p} for edit propagation. In FAVE, an inversion-free editing method, the two guidance evaluations are intended to play different roles: the target-conditioned prediction should follow the edited first frame and target prompt, whereas the source-conditioned reference should preserve the original scene structure using the source first frame and prompt. paragraphs.en: We presented VidEdit3D, which reformulates reference-guided 3D scene editing as I2V propagation by bridging static multi-view observations with the spatiotemporal priors of pretrained video diffusion models. TGR organizes selected 3D views into coherent video-like streams for edit propagation. FAVE enables robust semantic propagation through an inversion-free flow formulation, while ECG uses scheduled image conditioning to maintain a clearer source-to-target direction in DiT-based I2V models. RS-GS confines updates to target regions during final 3D optimization, reducing background leakage and better preserving unedited scene content. Together, these components enable high-fidelity, view-consistent edits across diverse viewpoints and challenging structural modifications without network fine-tuning. VidEdit3D shows how pretrained video priors support flexible 3D editing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 VidEdit3D，它通过将静态多视角观测与预训练视频扩散模型的时空先验相桥接，把参考引导的三维场景编辑重新表述为 I2V 传播。 TGR 将选定的三维视角组织成连贯的、类似视频的序列，用于编辑传播。 FAVE 通过无反演的流公式实现稳健的语义传播，而 ECG 利用调度图像条件控制，在基于 DiT 的 I2V 模型中保持更清晰的源到目标方向。 RS-GS 在最终三维优化过程中将更新限制在目标区域内，减少了背景泄漏，并更好地保留了未编辑的场景内容。 这些组件共同实现了跨多样视角和挑战性结构修改的高保真、视角一致的编辑，且无需网络微调。 VidEdit3D 展示了预训练视频先验如何支持灵活的三维编辑。

sents.zh: TGR 将选定的三维视角组织成连贯的、类似视频的序列，用于编辑传播。

sents.en: FAVE enables robust semantic propagation through an inversion-free flow formulation, while ECG uses scheduled image conditioning to maintain a clearer source-to-target direction in DiT-based I2V models.
sents.zh: FAVE 通过无反演的流公式实现稳健的语义传播，而 ECG 利用调度图像条件控制，在基于 DiT 的 I2V 模型中保持更清晰的源到目标方向。

sents.en: RS-GS confines updates to target regions during final 3D optimization, reducing background leakage and better preserving unedited scene content.
sents.zh: RS-GS 在最终三维优化过程中将更新限制在目标区域内，减少了背景泄漏，并更好地保留了未编辑的场景内容。

sents.en: Together, these components enable high-fidelity, view-consistent edits across diverse viewpoints and challenging structural modifications without network fine-tuning.
sents.zh: 这些组件共同实现了跨多样视角和挑战性结构修改的高保真、视角一致的编辑，且无需网络微调。

sents.en: VidEdit3D shows how pretrained video priors support flexible 3D editing.
sents.zh: VidEdit3D 展示了预训练视频先验如何支持灵活的三维编辑。

paragraphs.en: We use N = 4 N=4 keyframes for small scenes and N = 7 N=7 for large scenes, including the user-selected anchor in both cases. The keyframe count is fixed for each scene. Candidate views are screened using CLIP ViT-H/14 similarity to a description of the source subject carrying the edit. A view is retained when its similarity is at least 0.15 and at least 0.74 times the source anchor similarity. For example, adding glasses uses a description of the person’s head. We also project the reconstructed subject points into each candidate camera and require at least 90% of these points to lie in front of the camera and inside the image. paragraphs.zh: 我们在小场景中使用 N = 4 个关键帧，在大场景中使用 N = 7 个关键帧，两种情况均包含用户选择的锚点。 每个场景的关键帧数量是固定的。 候选视角通过 CLIP ViT-H/14 与承载编辑的源主体描述之间的相似度进行筛选。 当某个视角的相似度至少为 0.15 且至少为源锚点相似度的 0.74 倍时，该视角被保留。 例如，添加眼镜时使用对该人物头部的描述。 我们还将重建的主体点投影到每个候选相机中，并要求至少 90% 的这些点位于相机前方且在图像内。 我们排除投影主体在图像中占比过小或过大，或偏离图像中心过远的视角。 重复的相机位姿会被移除。

paragraphs.en: Before editing, we score every unedited rendered frame with the same source-subject description. A clip is accepted when its minimum frame similarity is at least 0.74 times that of the original anchor render; the anchor score must also reach 0.15. Both propagation branches use this same anchor reference, and each stops at its first rejected clip. Within each accepted branch, the edited last frame of one clip conditions the next.

paragraphs.en: Table 3 compares VidEdit3D with Wan adaptations of ViP3DE and FlowAlign [ 19 ] . ViP3DE-Wan replaces SVD while retaining ViP3DE’s inversion-based initialization, motion-preserved noise blending, 3D correspondences, and conditional-branch feature override. ViP3DE injects first-frame features into 3D-corresponding positions at the final SVD U-Net layer during every denoising step [ 6 ] ; we transfer this intervention to its direct DiT counterpart. The edited anchor, camera views, resolution, sampling steps, and random seeds remain identical. FlowAlign-Wan adapts FlowAlign to Wan2.1-I2V-14B and uses the same edited anchor, TGR trajectories, and RS-GS refinement as VidEdit3D.
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 将 VidEdit3D 与 ViP3DE 和 FlowAlign [19] 的 Wan 适配版本进行了比较。 ViP3DE-Wan 替换了 SVD，同时保留了 ViP3DE 基于反演的初始化、保运动噪声混合、3D 对应关系以及条件分支特征覆盖。 ViP3DE 在每个去噪步骤中，于最后一个 SVD U-Net 层将首帧特征注入 3D 对应位置 [6]；我们将这一干预迁移到其直接对应的 DiT 上。 编辑后的锚点、相机视角、分辨率、采样步数和随机种子保持完全一致。 FlowAlign-Wan 将 FlowAlign 适配到 Wan2.1-I2V-14B，并使用与 VidEdit3D 相同的编辑后锚点、TGR 轨迹和 RS-GS 精修。

paragraphs.en: The edited anchor determines the visual content transferred to the 3D scene. Background artifacts and incomplete object removal in the anchor can therefore persist after propagation and 3D refinement. A clean, target-visible anchor reduces these errors, and stronger 2D editors can be incorporated without retraining the propagation model. RS-GS preserves the attributes of unselected Gaussians, although their rendered visibility can change as the edited target changes shape.
paragraphs.zh: 编辑后的锚点决定了传输到3D场景的视觉内容。 因此，锚点中的背景伪影和未完全移除的物体可能在传播和3D优化后仍然存在。 一个干净且在目标视角可见的锚点可以减少这些误差，并且可以引入更强的2D编辑器而无需重新训练传播模型。 RS-GS保留了未选中高斯体的属性，尽管随着编辑目标形状的变化，其渲染可见性可能发生改变。

sents.en: The edited anchor determines the visual content transferred to the 3D scene.
sents.zh: 编辑后的锚点决定了传输到3D场景的视觉内容。

sents.en: Background artifacts and incomplete object removal in the anchor can therefore persist after propagation and 3D refinement.
sents.zh: 因此，锚点中的背景伪影和未完全移除的物体可能在传播和3D优化后仍然存在。

sents.en: A clean, target-visible anchor reduces these errors, and stronger 2D editors can be incorporated without retraining the propagation model.
sents.zh: 一个干净且在目标视角可见的锚点可以减少这些误差，并且可以引入更强的2D编辑器而无需重新训练传播模型。

sents.en: RS-GS preserves the attributes of unselected Gaussians, although their rendered visibility can change as the edited target changes shape.
sents.zh: RS-GS保留了未选中高斯体的属性，尽管随着编辑目标形状的变化，其渲染可见性可能发生改变。

paragraphs.en: Large-area texture or style edits leave little unchanged context to anchor propagation. FAVE uses source-consistency regularization to preserve scene layout, but transferring a new appearance across substantial visibility changes becomes harder when most visible surfaces are edited. The target appearance can then drift or fade toward the source appearance in later views. Fig. 11 illustrates this dependence on scene context.
paragraphs.zh: 大面积的纹理或风格编辑会留下很少未改变的上下文来锚定传播。 FAVE 使用源一致性正则化来保留场景布局，但当大多数可见表面都被编辑时，在显著的可见性变化下迁移新外观变得更加困难。 目标外观随后可能在后续视图中漂移或消退，趋近于源外观。 图 11 展示了这种对场景上下文的依赖性。

sents.en: Large-area texture or style edits leave little unchanged context to anchor propagation.
sents.zh: 大面积的纹理或风格编辑会留下很少未改变的上下文来锚定传播。

sents.en: FAVE uses source-consistency regularization to preserve scene layout, but transferring a new appearance across substantial visibility changes becomes harder when most visible surfaces are edited.
sents.zh: FAVE 使用源一致性正则化来保留场景布局，但当大多数可见表面都被编辑时，在显著的可见性变化下迁移新外观变得更加困难。

sents.en: The target appearance can then drift or fade toward the source appearance in later views.
sents.zh: 目标外观随后可能在后续视图中漂移或消退，趋近于源外观。

sents.en: Fig. 11 illustrates this dependence on scene context.
sents.zh: 图 11 展示了这种对场景上下文的依赖性。

paragraphs.en: A wider rendering field of view introduces more unedited context and can help sustain the target appearance along the trajectory. This reduces the target’s image resolution, however, making fine-grained appearance transfer less accurate after 3D refinement. Balancing contextual support with target resolution remains a direction for improving large-area editing.
paragraphs.zh: 更宽的渲染视场会引入更多未编辑的上下文，有助于沿轨迹维持目标外观。 然而这会降低目标的图像分辨率，使得三维精细化后的细粒度外观迁移不够精确。 如何在上下文支持与目标分辨率之间取得平衡，仍是改进大面积编辑的一个方向。

sents.en: A wider rendering field of view introduces more unedited context and can help sustain the target appearance along the trajectory.
sents.zh: 更宽的渲染视场会引入更多未编辑的上下文，有助于沿轨迹维持目标外观。

sents.en: This reduces the target’s image resolution, however, making fine-grained appearance transfer less accurate after 3D refinement.
sents.zh: 然而这会降低目标的图像分辨率，使得三维精细化后的细粒度外观迁移不够精确。

sents.en: Balancing contextual support with target resolution remains a direction for improving large-area editing.
sents.zh: 如何在上下文支持与目标分辨率之间取得平衡，仍是改进大面积编辑的一个方向。

paragraphs.en: Computational efficiency remains a limitation. Our Wan2.1-I2V-14B backbone requires repeated denoiser evaluations over dense multi-view clips, making interactive editing costly. Sparse attention [ 54 , 56 , 28 ] , feature caching [ 31 , 63 ] , model distillation [ 59 ] , and learned few-step solvers [ 62 ] offer promising ways to reduce this cost. Integrating these techniques while preserving reference fidelity and multi-view consistency is an important direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 计算效率仍然是一个限制因素。 我们的 Wan2.1-I2V-14B 骨干网络需要对稠密多视角片段进行反复的去噪器评估，使得交互式编辑成本高昂。 稀疏注意力 [ 54 , 56 , 28 ]、特征缓存 [ 31 , 63 ]、模型蒸馏 [ 59 ] 以及学习式少步求解器 [ 62 ] 为降低这一成本提供了有前景的方法。 在保持参考保真度和多视角一致性的同时整合这些技术，是未来工作的一个重要方向。
